Best practices and knowledge sharing: Learn and apply best-known methods (BKMs), and share learnings with peers and technicians as part of project execution. Education and experience B.S. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Device Physics, or related technical field. 2+ years of experience driving defect reduction and yield enhancement in CMOS/BiCMOS or bipolar technologies and semiconductor unit processes. Strong communication skills (written, verbal, presentation). Strong analytical/problem-solving skills; able to make decisions using data. We're looking for a Growth Brand Designer to sit at the intersection of brand craft and growth performance. You'll be the designer who makes Perplexity's highest-volume, highest-leverage marketing surfaces — paid ads, social, lifecycle email, and campaign assets — look unmistakably Perplexity while actually moving the numbers.

This is a shipping role, but it's equally a thinking role. Strategic concepting is a big part of the job: you'll sit with the Growth team as an ideator — generating campaign concepts, testing hypotheses, and shaping the creative strategy behind the work — not just executing briefs handed to you. The ideas you bring to the table matter as much as the assets you ship.

You'll produce a steady stream of ad and campaign creative across formats and channels, then work with Growth to read the results and iterate. You care about conversion and craft in equal measure: you'd never ship an off-brand asset to win a test, and you'd never hide behind polish when the data says a concept isn't working.

You'll report into the Brand/Creative Studio team and work closely with Growth, Product Marketing, Brand, and our motion and web designers.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Drive strategic concepting for growth campaigns — bring original ideas, angles, and creative territories to the table, and shape the brief rather than just receiving it

- Operate as a true ideation partner to the Growth team: co-develop campaign strategy, propose test hypotheses, and pitch concepts that open up new creative directions

- Own the design of growth creative end-to-end — paid social and display ads, campaign assets, and lifecycle email — from concept to shipped asset

- Design for volume and velocity: build variant sets, test hypotheses, and iterate on winners with the Growth team using real performance data

- Turn product launches and GTM campaigns into ad creative that lands on every channel it runs — static, animated, and everything in between

- Build and maintain scalable ad and email templates so high-frequency asset production stays fast and on-brand

- Partner with Brand to keep visual consistency across every growth touchpoint as our brand system evolves

- Collaborate with our motion designer and web designer so campaigns feel cohesive from the first ad impression to the landing page

- Bring a strong point of view on what makes performance creative great — and push back when a "best practice" would cheapen the brand

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- A strong portfolio of growth and brand design work — paid ads, social campaigns, lifecycle email, campaign systems — that shows both craft and results

- Proven strategic concepting ability: you can show campaigns where the idea was yours, not just the execution, and articulate the thinking behind them

- Excellent visual design skills with a clear sense of brand, typography, layout, and composition

- Hands-on experience designing performance creative at a consumer or prosumer tech company, including working directly with growth or performance marketing teams

- Fluency reading creative performance data (CTR, conversion, hook rates) and translating it into design decisions

- Ability to work fast, manage a high volume of deliverables across channels, and iterate quickly without dropping the quality bar

- Fluency in Figma and the Adobe Creative Suite

- An instinct for building repeatable systems — templates, variant frameworks, asset kits — rather than one-off files

- 5+ years of industry experience

NICE TO HAVE

- Motion design skills — animated ads, short-form video for social, or After Effects fluency

- Familiarity with ad platform specs and constraints (Meta, Google, TikTok, X, YouTube) and how they shape creative decisions

- Experience using AI-assisted design and image-generation workflows to scale creative output

- Copywriting instincts — you can tighten a headline when there's no writer in the room

Job Category Product Job Details About Salesforce Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. Salesforce recherche un(e) Technical Product Strategist (Stratège Produit Technique) pour rejoindre son équipe Product Strategy & Innovation. C'est une opportunité unique d'évoluer à la croisée des dynamiques de marché, du positionnement produit et de l'architecture technique complexe, en contribuant à définir où Salesforce investit, comment nous positionnons notre plateforme et pourquoi. Vous contribuerez à notre thèse technologique prospective. Plutôt que de gérer des backlogs de sprint, la priorisation de fonctionnalités ou des feuilles de route d'exécution à court terme, vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe de stratèges produit techniques pour identifier les opportunités émergentes (« white spaces »), évaluer les options « build-buy-partner » (développer, acheter ou s'associer) et traduire les grandes tendances du marché en stratégies de plateforme concrètes. Nous recherchons un(e) professionnel(le) de la stratégie capable d'anticiper les tendances : une personne sachant analyser méthodiquement les lacunes du portefeuille, évaluer les options d'investissement technique et aider à concevoir les cadres stratégiques qui façonneront notre plateforme d'entreprise. De l'analyse des trajectoires de produitisation des capacités clés (de l'infrastructure de confiance à l'automatisation des flux de travail en passant par les architectures d'IA agentique) à la recherche de thèses d'investissement dans des secteurs à forte croissance comme l'agentification de la chaîne logistique, les outils pour développeurs et les systèmes de référence natifs de l'IA (« AI-native systems of record »), vous aiderez Salesforce à miser sur les bons choix grâce à des modèles commerciaux et techniques solides. Ce que vous ferez : Soutenir la stratégie produit à long terme : Mener des études de marché, des analyses d'opportunités (« whitespace ») et des évaluations concurrentielles afin de soutenir les cadres de positionnement pluriannuels sur l'ensemble du portefeuille d'IA d'entreprise et de plateforme de Salesforce. Analyser les trajectoires de produitisation : Évaluer la transition stratégique des capacités techniques internes (infrastructure de confiance, automatisation des flux de travail, IA agentique et plateformes de données) vers des gammes de produits autonomes ou des offres intégrées à la plateforme. Appliquer les cadres « Build-Buy-Partner » : Mener des évaluations structurelles pour les décisions de développement interne, d'acquisition ou de partenariat, en analysant les délais d'intégration à la plateforme par rapport aux stratégies de commercialisation (« go-to-market ») indépendantes. Traduire les paradigmes technologiques et de marché : Suivre les mutations fondamentales (notamment le codage agentique, les architectures d'applications natives de l'IA, l'automatisation de la chaîne logistique et les écosystèmes open source) et les traduire en thèses d'investissement claires et appuyées par les données. Cartographier les lacunes du portefeuille : Collaborer avec les responsables de la stratégie et de la gestion produit pour identifier les vulnérabilités du portefeuille et les opportunités de marché au-delà de l'analyse concurrentielle classique. Synthétiser les signaux transversaux : Intégrer la recherche technique, les capacités d'ingénierie, la veille stratégique de marché et les tendances M&A (fusions-acquisitions) dans des perspectives stratégiques solides et étayées. Évaluer la viabilité du marché : Effectuer le dimensionnement du marché, la modélisation économique et des analyses concurrentielles pour justifier l'allocation de capital et les réorientations stratégiques. Soutenir les initiatives stratégiques mondiales : Travailler avec la direction régionale pour adapter les stratégies de plateforme aux marchés internationaux, en tenant compte des cadres réglementaires locaux et du paysage concurrentiel. Évaluer les modèles de commercialisation (« Go-to-Market ») : Analyser les structures de monétisation (open source, intégration à la plateforme, SaaS autonome, API-first) en équilibrant le potentiel de revenus à long terme, l'adoption par les développeurs et la défendabilité. Surveiller les signaux émergents : Suivre l'activité du capital-risque, les évolutions de l'écosystème de développeurs et les recherches émergentes afin d'identifier les nouveaux paradigmes technologiques avant qu'ils ne fassent consensus. Formuler des recommandations pour le comité directeur : Rédiger des notes stratégiques et des présentations claires et bien structurées destinées aux directeurs de la stratégie, VP Produit et dirigeants exécutifs. Vous êtes la personne idéale si vous avez : 5 à 8 ans d'expérience (post-licence ou diplôme supérieur) en stratégie produit, stratégie technologique, stratégie d'entreprise, conseil en management ou gestion de produit technique au sein d'une entreprise majeure du cloud ou de logiciels d'entreprise. Solide compréhension structurelle des architectures IA/ML d'entreprise, des systèmes agentiques et des schémas d'intégration de plateformes. Maîtrise des systèmes de référence d'entreprise, des plateformes de données et des infrastructures SaaS, incluant la compréhension de l'impact des couches d'IA sur le modèle économique du logiciel. Solides bases en conception de modèles économiques, notamment les compromis entre les modèles de commercialisation open source, propriétaires, natifs de plateforme et axés sur les API. Expérience dans la participation aux évaluations « build-buy-partner », aux stratégies d'entrée sur le marché ou aux études de marché pour les fusions-acquisitions. Excellentes compétences en communication et en présentation, avec une aptitude éprouvée à traduire des sujets techniques complexes et multivariables en récits synthétiques pour les dirigeants. Forte aisance face à l'ambiguïté et solides compétences en résolution de problèmes quantitatifs et qualitatifs pour structurer des enjeux complexes et tester des hypothèses stratégiques. Encore mieux si vous avez : Diplôme de niveau Master (MBA, Master of Science ou équivalent) dans un domaine commercial ou technique. Expérience en stratégie technique, innovation d'entreprise ou conseil en stratégie technologique. Connaissance des écosystèmes de plateformes pour développeurs, du développement logiciel assisté par IA et des outils de développement modernes. Expérience pratique ou connaissance approfondie dans l'automatisation de la chaîne logistique d'entreprise, l'agentification des processus ou les applications d'IA sectorielles (« vertical AI »). Expérience en capital-risque (venture capital), développement d'entreprise (corporate development) ou analyse d'investissements technologiques. Un esprit d'entrepreneur/constructeur (« builder ») axé sur l'évaluation de nouveaux marchés, de nouveaux modèles économiques et de paradigmes émergents plutôt que sur l'optimisation des fonctionnalités existantes. ***Veuillez postuler avec un CV en anglais*** Salesforce is seeking a Technical Product Strategist to join our Product Strategy & Innovation team. This is a unique opportunity to operate at the intersection of market dynamics, product positioning, and complex technical architecture—helping define where Salesforce invests, how we position our platform, and why. You will contribute to our forward-looking technology thesis. Rather than managing sprint backlogs, feature prioritization, or short-term execution roadmaps, you will work within a team of technical product strategists to identify emerging white spaces, evaluate build-buy-partner options, and translate macro market shifts into actionable platform strategies. Analyze Productization Pathways: Evaluate the strategic transition of internal technical capabilities—trust infrastructure, workflow automation, agentic AI, and data platforms—into standalone product lines or platform-integrated offerings. Apply Build-Buy-Partner Frameworks: Execute structural evaluations for build vs. buy vs. partner decisions, analyzing platform integration timelines versus independent go-to-market strategies. Translate Market & Tech Paradigms: Track foundational shifts—including agentic coding, AI-native application architectures, supply chain automation, and open-source ecosystems—and translate them into clear, data-driven investment theses. Map Portfolio Gaps: Collaborate with strategy leads and product management to identify portfolio vulnerabilities and market opportunities beyond standard competitive analysis. Synthesize Cross-Functional Signals: Integrate technical research, engineering capabilities, market intelligence, and M&A trends into defensible strategic perspectives. Assess Market Viability: Perform market sizing, economic modeling, and competitive analyses to help justify capital allocation and strategic shifts. Support Global Strategy Initiatives: Work with regional leadership to adapt platform strategies for international markets, accounting for local regulatory frameworks and competitive landscapes. Evaluate Go-to-Market Models: Analyze monetization frameworks—open source, platform-bundled, standalone SaaS, API-first—balancing long-term revenue potential, developer adoption, and defensibility. Monitor Horizon Signals: Track venture capital activity, developer ecosystem shifts, and emerging research to surface tech paradigms before they become industry consensus. Deliver Executive Recommendations: Draft clear, well-structured strategic memos and presentations for strategy directors, product VPs, and senior leadership. You're Our Person If You Have: 5–8 years of experience (post-undergrad or post-grad degree) across product strategy, technology strategy, corporate strategy, management consulting, or technical product management at a leading cloud platform or enterprise software company. Strong structural understanding of enterprise AI/ML architectures, agentic systems, and platform integration patterns. Fluency in enterprise systems of record, data platforms, and SaaS infrastructure, including an understanding of how AI layers impact software economics. Solid grounding in business model design, including the trade-offs between open-source, proprietary, platform-native, and API commercialization models. Experience contributing to build-buy-partner evaluations, market entry strategies, or M&A market research. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with a track record of translating complex, multi-variable technical topics into clear executive narratives. High comfort with ambiguity and strong quantitative/qualitative problem-solving skills to define unstructured problems and test strategic hypotheses. Even Better If You Have: Master’s degree (MBA, MS, or equivalent) in a business or technical field. Background in technical strategy, corporate innovation, or tech strategy consulting. Domain exposure to enterprise supply chain automation, process agentification, or vertical AI applications. Experience in venture capital, corporate development, or tech investment analysis. A builder's mindset focused on evaluating new markets, business models, and emerging paradigms rather than optimizing existing feature backlogs. Unleash Your Potential When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Responsibilities include:
- Develop, implement, and manage supply chain strategies on a global scale
- Drive the strategic aspects of large complex cross-functional projects
- Develop and maintain supplier capacity modeling
- Understand demand inputs and position supply to support unconstrained growth at AWS scale in both the short-term and long-term horizons
- Engage with global supply chain counterparts to drive leading supply chain practices and initiatives
- Drive innovation through the supply chain and influence industry practices
- Develop analytical reports to deliver information to business partners and stakeholders that support improved decision making
- Manage supplier lead times and drive them to meet AWS business requirements
- Manage supplier performance and allocation of material to demands based on priority
- Be a subject matter expert for the customers, technologies, and markets in which you engage
- Manage cross-functional projects against plans and objectives to meet commitments and goals
- Identify and drive realization of opportunities for sustainable, scalable, relative advantage in your category
- Requires travel up to 15% of the year

Function Specific Work Activities:
- Analyze industry trends and evolving technology to proactively identify supply base opportunities to minimize risk, protect continuity of supply, and utilize industry developments that benefit Amazon
- Identify and pursue opportunities to leverage and consolidate the supply base using system level tools and techniques
- Understand forecasting, demand planning, material planning, and manufacturing processes to verify supply commitments
- Manage supply buffers and allocation to shorten lead times and build resiliency into the supply chain without driving excess
- Drive supplier improvement initiatives to continually lower risk and reduce lead times
- Influence suppliers' manufacturing processes, technology decisions, and policies in ways that are mutually beneficial and sustainable for both organizations

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

jobs.description: Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv. We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv. Job Title Risk Investigation Supervisor Job Title : Credit Risk Supervisor About your role: We are seeking driven and people-focused Credit Risk Supervisor to lead a credit risk operations team, which may support areas such as risk investigations, underwriting, triage, merchant review, or related workflows. In this role, you will oversee daily workflow management, decision quality, operational performance, and employee development while ensuring risk, compliance, and service level expectations are consistently achieved. The ideal candidate is a strong leader who can motivate teams, manage competing priorities, support sound risk-based decisioning, and drive continuous improvement. Success in this role requires excellent communication skills, strong attention to detail, sound judgment, process management expertise, and the ability to collaborate effectively across credit risk, operations, sales, compliance, and other business partners. What You'll Do Lead and develop an assigned credit risk operations team, which may include risk investigations, underwriting, triage, merchant review, or related workflows. Oversee daily workload, queue management, service levels, quality standards, and business objectives to ensure timely and accurate risk decisions. Coach and mentor team members, providing performance feedback, decisioning guidance, and support for career growth and development. Review escalated cases and complex risk scenarios, helping teams apply policies, procedures, and sound judgment to support consistent outcomes. Analyze operational and risk performance trends, identify root causes, and implement solutions that improve quality, efficiency, and control effectiveness. Partner with internal stakeholders across credit risk, operations, sales, compliance, and product teams to resolve issues, optimize processes, and support strategic initiatives. Maintain a strong focus on risk management, regulatory compliance, policy adherence, and operational excellence. What you need to have Must be organized, intuitive and an analytical thinker, with the ability to perform detailed credit and data analysis in a fast paced environment. Strong written, oral and interpersonal skills a must including a strong ability to explain and/or present analysis to senior management, bank partners, external stakeholders, legal and ultimately our merchants. Strong financial analysis skills with an emphasis on reading Business Financial Statements. Strong business judgement with demonstrated ability to think strategically and creatively. Must be timely with tasks and proactive by seeking out solutions and problem resolution. Proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, Word and comfortable learning and aid in developing new internal systems. What would be great to have : Preferred education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Management, Finance, Economics, Statistics or related quantitative discipline. Preferred experience: 6-8 years of proven credit risk experience in middle market / corporate bank lending, merchant acquiring risk focused on middle market / enterprise clients and/or asset based lending. Thank you for considering employment with Fiserv. Please: Apply using your legal name Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable). Our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law. Note to agencies: Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions. Warning about fake job posts: Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

jobs.description: Witaj w Warner Bros. Discovery, gdzie marzenia stają się rzeczywistością. Dowiedz się, kim jesteśmy... Mamy nadzieję, że będą Ci bliskie i chętnie omówimy je podczas rozmowy rekrutacyjnej. Wspieranie inkluzywności w WBD W Warner Bros. Discovery zależy nam na budowaniu zespołu, który łączy różne perspektywy, doświadczenia i środowiska. Jako pracodawca zapewniający równe szanse oceniamy kandydatów na podstawie ich kompetencji i doświadczenia, niezależnie od płci, tożsamości płciowej, pochodzenia etnicznego, wieku, orientacji seksualnej, religii lub przekonań, stanu cywilnego, ciąży, rodzicielstwa, niepełnosprawności czy innych cech chronionych prawem.
